 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 16/04/2024 1. The instant criminal misc. petitions under Section 482 Cr.P.C. have been preferred by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No.183/2021 registered at Police Station Rawla, District Sri Ganganagar for the offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Rawla, District Sri Ganganagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Both the learned counsels for the petitioners pray for quashing the aforementioned FIR and all further proceedings in pursuant thereof.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposes the submission of learned counsels for the petitioners for quashing of the FIR and all further proceedings in pursuant thereof.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the niceties of the matter, it is felt appropriate to direct that the petitioners shall not be arrested during the entire course of investigation.
Instead thereof, if offence is found proved, then the Investigating Officer shall inform the petitioners to appear before the trial Court on the date of filing of charge-sheet.

5. On the day of filing of the charge-sheet and upon the appearance of the petitioners, they shall move a regular bail application under Section 437 of the Cr.P.C. and whereupon the learned trial Court shall release them on bail on the very same day; on the amount of surety and bond as it deems fit.
[2024:RJ-JD:16681] (3 of 3) [CRLMP-2361/2023]
6.
Accordingly, the instant criminal misc. petitions as well as the stay petitions are disposed of.
(FARJAND ALI),J Abhishek Kumar Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
